name: Temple University, Japan Campus
summary: Tokyo campus of a US university, founded 1982: classes in English, Temple degrees, 14 majors, no Japanese needed to start.

ib.text: Applicants need the full IB Diploma: predicted grades while at school, then the official IB transcript. Non-native speakers submit TOEFL, IELTS or a similar English test. No minimum IB score is published.

dates.label: Fall Early Action deadline (yearly date; non-binding, priority review)
Fall deadline for applicants needing a student visa through TUJ (yearly date)

notes: Full-time tuition is ¥910,000 a semester (12 to 18 credits); new students also pay a ¥434,100 matriculation fee, and TUJ states it can change without notice.
First-year students on a new student visa must live in a TUJ dormitory, at ¥940,000 to ¥1,200,000 a year depending on the room.
Admission is rolling and TUJ says you can apply up to three semesters ahead; the Diamond Scholarship needs an application by 15 October the year before entry.
